title: In VM without gpu acceleration, `electron-nightly` Wayland window doesn't show up
body:
### Preflight Checklist

- [x] I have read the [Contributing Guidelines](https://github.com/electron/electron/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) for this project.
- [x] I agree to follow the [Code of Conduct](https://github.com/electron/electron/blob/main/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md) that this project adheres to.
- [x] I have searched the [issue tracker](https://www.github.com/electron/electron/issues) for a bug report that matches the one I want to file, without success.

### Electron Version

40.0.0-nightly.20250915

### What operating system(s) are you using?

Other Linux

### Operating System Version

Fedora 42

### What arch are you using?

x64

### Last Known Working Electron version

Unknown

### Does the issue also appear in Chromium / Google Chrome?

No

### Expected Behavior

See below 

### Actual Behavior

`npx electron-nightly` - no Wayland window shows up

```
Exiting GPU process due to errors during initialization 
```

`npx electron-nightly --disable-gpu` - Wayland window shows up

### Testcase Gist URL

_No response_

### Additional Information

_No response_

comments.body:
Thanks for the repro!

You mention `npx electron` as the reproduction, but this doesn't run the nightly. It will run v38.1.0.

Could you please post a repro with a nightly version?

More specifically

- running flatpak Gnome Boxes
- with a VM of fedora server 42 (no 3D acceleration)
- https://github.com/reporter/FedoraServerLabwc
- in labwc, click desktop for Terminal 
```
sudo dnf install nodejs
mkdir proj
cd proj
npm install electron-nightly
npx electron-nightly
```

comments.author: reporter
comments.body:
This issue doesn't happen with already built apps, it only happens with the default command `npx electron` app and `npx electron index.html`

Commands such as `npx electron index.js` don't give this issue 

I just tried the `min` browser which uses electron 38 and no issues

comments.body:
> This issue doesn't happen with already built apps, it only happens with the default command npx electron app and npx electron index.html

FWIW I've seen this bug with a packaged app on Electron 38.2.2 with a fresh install of Fedora.

comments.author: participant2
comments.body: It might be some sort of race condition and therefore slightly vary with how it happens. I've actually seen it work on some machines sometimes and not work on others, for the exact same programs with what I think were the same electron versions.

comments.author: participant4

I spinned up my Manjaro VM which is using KDE and wayland. Im not experiencing any issues over there. Could this maybe be related to GNOME?

Edit: Going to setup a fresh Manjaro VM that uses GNOME to test this theory

comments.author: participant4
comments.body:
Test results (so far), using wayland (always verified it by running `echo $XDG_SESSION_TYPE`) and gpu acceleration disabled:
* ✅ = Window shows up
* ❌= Window doesnt show up


Distro | Desktop Environment | Electron Version < v38 | Electron Version > v38
-- | -- | -- | --
Manjaro | GNOME | ✅ | ❌ 
Manjaro | KDE  | ✅ | ✅
Fedora | GNOME | ✅ | ❌
Fedora | KDE | ✅ |  ✅ 
Ubuntu | GNOME | ✅ | ❌
Ubuntu | KDE |  | 

From initial testing it seems like this is related to GNOME. I would encourage others to chime in and verify this information.
